title: homemade saudi-arabian celery salad
description: a refreshing winey celery salad inspired by saudi-arabian cuisine - featuring a tangy fermented kimchi and dairy-free friendly ingredients. perfect for a brunch gathering or as a light snack.
instructions: chop the celery into thin strips.
mix together lemon juice and olive oil in a bowl.
add the chopped celery and kimchi to the bowl and toss until well coated.
grate the garlic and add it to the bowl.
add the chopped walnuts and mix well.
season with celery salt, salt, and black pepper.
taste and adjust seasoning if needed.
cover and refrigerate for at least 30 minutes before serving.
garnish with fresh parsley before serving.
serve at room temperature for a different twist.
consider adding diced egg for extra protein.
add a dollop of mayo for extra creaminess
